title: chart-orient
intention: STONE 1 of the chart device: the ORIENT NEXUS v0 + the /chart skill's first stage (merged at cast — the ceiling needs a runner). One narrow question: WHAT IS ACTUALLY BEING ASKED, AND WHERE DOES IT LIVE? Two strata ship: the DETERMINISTIC FLOOR (cairn/machines/chart/orient.py — request parsing + existence verification, with TERRITORY measurement COMPOSED from the orient instrument's device_census, never a parallel scan) and the CLAUDE CEILING (the /chart skill's mini agentic loop, curtain held as stated discipline: read only the request + floor facts, never the target folders). The exit artifact is the orient packet — intent/domain/scope/refs/unknowns/confidence/provenance — refused at the gate (validate_orient, the append-door pattern) on missing fields, malformed confidence, provenance not covering every authored field, or ANY ref the floor cannot verify exists. Packets berth in instance-space (~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/); the tree stratum is the next stone.
why: The parent's why, made concrete first here because premature convergence was MEASURED at home (the web-server carrier miss) and orientation is where it strikes. Akien's skill-door facts make the delivery mechanism: the preamble lives behind /chart, and the floor runs BEFORE the ceiling reasons — the request grounded against what exists, not what the nearest pattern suggests.
traces_to: Law 1 — the floor composes the SETTLED measurer (cairn/tools/orient) instead of re-deriving scans; a recurring orientation compiles into the tree stratum next stone
Law 3 — floor output is measurement (exists/missing, never merged); confidence and per-field provenance travel as data
Law 4 — the schema gate at the handoff; an invented ref physically cannot reach downstream
Law 6 — one door into the house (the import-allowlist tooth pins cairn.tools.orient.orient as the ONLY cairn import)
Law 7 — every refusal is loud and names its cause; the packet berth validates at the door and a refused packet leaves nothing behind it

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: cairn/machines/chart/proofs/test_chart_orient.py — 12 teeth under the tester's netns seal, validation persisted beside-code. Live gate at LEARNME: /chart's stage-1 protocol fired on a REAL request (the next stone's own work), floor + ceiling + gate + berth, reported honestly.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: the floor scanning territory in parallel with the orient instrument (the composition tooth); a floor answer crossing from what-exists into what-applies; an invented ref passing the gate; a packet field without provenance; found and missing merged; a refused packet leaving residue behind the write door; a second cairn import in orient.py.
falsifier.horizon: re-read when the tree stratum lands (the walk between floor and ceiling), when /chart runs on enough real tasks to read the dial (fields by floor vs tree vs claude), and when the curtain gets its physics (parent edge b).
